title: Variance of the second counterexample function
statement: On the three-dimensional sign cube, let the function be the one defined by the parameter $t=2+\sqrt{33}/3$ in the displayed polynomial in the three sign coordinates. Its variance under the uniform distribution on the cube is $11/8+5\sqrt{33}/24$.
